usage: Use 施肥 when talking about adding fertilizer to plants or soil. It is a common gardening word and sounds natural in everyday Cantonese.
The usual pattern is 施肥 + for a plant / garden, or 施肥 + at a time or season. In context, people often pair it with watering, pruning, and repotting.
It can also be used as a verb-like noun in practical speech, so you may hear someone say they are going to 施肥 to help plants grow better.
For learners: this word is neutral and common in gardening talk. It is not a formal science term, so it fits home gardening, balcony plants, and farm work.
